trip_charge_v1.first_started_at: Aware ISO timestamp of this native trip's original first Full start, or null. A temporary disconnect or reload does not grant a new start-time budget.
trip_charge_v1.timeout_at: Original absolute native trip timeout as an aware ISO timestamp, or null. Pauses and reconnects cannot extend it; it is separate from the selected departure.
trip_charge_v1.full_stop_reason: Persisted reason for the latest logical Full stop, or null. Only an explicitly disconnected stop matching the prior Full generation permits automatic trip pause/resumption; operator cancellation, completion, timeout and invalid data remain terminal.
trip_charge_v1.full_stop_generation: The pre-stop ON lease generation to which full_stop_reason applies, or null. This is provenance, not permission to adopt an unrelated newer Full request.
trip_charge_v1.full_stop_at: Aware ISO timestamp of the recorded logical Full stop, or null; not proof of physical charger response.
